descGuide.message: Everything the extension adds to Twitch, explained step by step with visual examples. Nothing to set up: everything works right away.

descScores.message: Channels ranked by how often you visit them. Read from your local history — no request is sent.

descSubs.message: Channels you are subscribed to, spotted while browsing and by reading your subscriptions page.

descRoster.message: All your followed channels: those in your sidebar, and the full list reread from your Following page every twelve hours.
descRoster.description: Description de la section chaînes connues

descRythme.message: When you open a channel, in local time. A visit counts once per channel per three-hour window: this is a rhythm, not watch time.

descDiagnose.message: Whether the extension still recognises Twitch's markup. A broken critical probe means part of it has stopped working.

descLag.message: How long Twitch takes to show a card after a stream starts, and the head start the extension gained.

navCycles.description: Section : cycles du voile de chargement

descCycles.message: When the overlay went up, why, and what brought it down.

descApercu.message: What happened during the last preview you hovered.

descBascules.message: Channels that changed category in the last ten minutes.

descGlobal.message: The world ranking the extension builds when Top Channels is on.

descCategories.message: Categories ranked by audience, as returned by Twitch.

stateAgendaCapped.message: Only $1 of your $2 followed channels are read: the live ones, your subscriptions, then the most visited.

stateAgendaNoSchedule.message: Twitch does not serve channel schedules: scheduled streams cannot be shown.

stateAgendaNoReplays.message: Twitch refuses the list of replays: only each channel's latest one is shown.

stateAgendaPartial.message: Twitch did not serve $1 channel(s); “Refresh” asks again.

stateAgendaNetwork.message: Twitch is not answering right now; “Refresh” will start reading again.

stateAgendaFollowSweep.message: Reading the full list of your followed channels…

stateAgendaIncomplete.message: This week reaches further back than the last hundred replays of $1 channel(s): not all of theirs are shown.

stateAgendaEmptyChannel.message: No streams from this channel this week.

stateAgendaNoOffline.message: All your followed channels are live.

stateAgendaNoRoster.message: No followed channel known yet. The extension learns them from Twitch's sidebar and your Following page while you are signed in.

stateAgendaRefused.message: Twitch refuses the schedule's requests; “Export a report” says why.

valSubOnlyLocked.message: For the channel's subscribers only — the extension doesn't know you're subscribed

valUnavailableTip.message: Twitch no longer serves this channel (noticed $1): usually an account suspended, renamed or closed. It comes back by itself if Twitch serves it again.

healthOk.description: Pastille : tous les sélecteurs critiques répondent

healthBroken.description: Pastille : au moins un sélecteur critique est cassé

resetText.message: Visit scores, spotted subscriptions, known channels and delay measurements will be deleted from this browser. This cannot be undone.

stateNoWorker.message: The extension’s background worker is not answering. Reload the extension, or reinstall the build made for this browser.
stateNoWorker.description: État : le service worker ne répond pas (à distinguer de « pas d'onglet Twitch »)

reportFailed.description: Échec total : ni téléchargement ni presse-papier

reportDesc.description: Description sous le titre : dit ce que le rapport contient et ne contient pas

btnRefresh.description: Bouton : reconstruit le rapport à l'instant

btnClose.description: Bouton : referme la vue du rapport

descOptions.message: What the extension adds, and what it leaves alone. Everything is on by default; a purple dot marks what you changed.

descSemaine.message: Your followed channels' streams, day by day: past ones with their replay, live ones, and scheduled ones.

descHorsLigne.message: Your followed channels that are not live, scheduled streams first: their last stream, its replay, and the next one if it is scheduled.

optDescApercuVideo.message: Off, the preview keeps its thumbnail, badges and timeline — it simply stops loading the video.

optDescApercuQualite.message: Applies to the next preview, no reload needed.

optDescSalle.message: A “▶” cursor, in the middle of a co-stream's bar, opens its streams together, on the page — on the bar of several channels as on that of a channel alone from its co-stream in the list. On hover, it stretches and says what it opens; the faces of those you don't follow appear beside it — move onto them, or Shift+click: the whole co-stream. Off: no cursor, no room; the bars stay.

optDescSalleAuto.message: The streams are synced by their shared sound — each stream's lips on its voice as you hear it. It takes about a minute of listening; without shared sound, nothing moves. Off: nothing moves on its own.

optDescZapping.message: A button to the right of the search magnifier opens your followed channels that are live, full screen, one after another: ↑ and ↓ to switch, Enter to open the channel, S to add it to the room, O to open the room, Esc to exit. The previous and next ones are already loaded; when the mouse stops moving, the interface fades away. The page's video pauses while you zap; an open room closes, and its streams are kept to reopen. Off: no button, no screen.

optDescAccueil.message: Above Twitch's rows: the carousel's streams, “Featured”, and the Top 15 in your language; at the top, the channel you watch the most. Off: the home page is Twitch's, as is, and nothing runs.

optDescAccueilTete.message: “Your #1 channel”: the live followed channel you watch the most — failing that, the one with the most viewers —, in place of Twitch's carousel, across the whole width; the carousel comes back when none of your followed channels is live. “Nothing” removes the carousel and stops its video.

optDescAccueilVideo.message: The stream starts in the banner, muted and ad-free, like the hover preview: the picture first, then the video, and the background takes on its colours. It stops when the banner leaves the screen or the tab is hidden. Off: the picture alone, refreshed every minute.

optDescAccueilUne.message: The streams of Twitch's carousel, as a row, when it is hidden — by the banner, or by “Nothing”. Their cards go through the request the sidebar already makes, while they are on screen.

optDescAccueilTop.message: The first fifteen places of Top Channels' exact ranking, in big numbers. An arrow shows what moved over thirty minutes, or since you arrived on the home page if that is more recent. Computed only while the home page is on screen.

optDescAccueilTopLangue.message: “Twitch's” follows the language of Twitch's interface.

optDescAccueilTopEcartees.message: The usernames on this list do not enter the Top 15, whatever its language — for a channel that carries the language's tag without speaking it. Top Channels, in the sidebar, is not affected. Fifteen at most.

optListeRefus.message: Not a Twitch username: $1 — letters, digits and _, as in the channel's address.

optListePleine.message: $1 at most: remove one to add another.

optAccueilApercu.message: Hover preview on the home page

optDescAccueilApercu.message: The sidebar's preview, on the home page cards: the extension's and Twitch's. Also follows “Show the preview”.

optDescAccueilDebut.message: On the extension's cards, a button that opens the replay of the stream in progress at its first second. Only when you can watch it: the channel keeps its replays and opens them to everyone, or you are subscribed to it.

optDescAccueilRdv.message: What your followed channels have scheduled for today and tomorrow, with the time left. “Remind me” puts an alert in your open Twitch tabs when the channel goes live. For a channel you watch that has nothing scheduled: the time its last streams started, when it repeats.

optDescAccueilEtiquettes.message: One fact, just one, on each home page card — the extension's and Twitch's alike: “Back after 41 days”, “Just started”, “↗ +38% in 10 min”, “#3 worldwide”… For a channel the sidebar doesn't follow, its numbers are requested while its card is on screen; worldwide and other-language places at the Top 15's pace.

optDescAccueilPulsation.message: A subtle, continuous pulse — the label keeps growing and shrinking — staggered from card to card, so it stands out from the thumbnail.

optDescAccueilAbsence.message: After twenty-four hours without Twitch on screen, a row of cards at the bottom of the home page says what your followed channels streamed in the meantime: their last replay's picture, their streams, the most viewed of their clips, and the last replay. One clips request per channel and per absence, which also carries the picture.

optDescAccueilPourquoi.message: For the channels you visit the most, what is live in their usual category, in Twitch's language, outside your follows — and the title says why. One request per row, two rows at most.

optDescAccueilRanger.message: On Twitch's own rows: “Hide” next to the title of a category row, live cards the size of the extension's, and the “?” thumbnails replaced by the last replay or the avatar. Its live cards take the extension's marks — the live badge, the viewer count alone, the duration top right —, their figures going through the request the sidebar already makes, while they are on screen. Nothing is removed from the page.

optDescAbonnes.message: "Subtle" keeps the colour and drops the shimmer. "None" gives the card back to Twitch.

optGrpListe.message: The list, its sorts and filters

optDescTopN.message: Above thirty, some languages lose an optimisation and the ranking takes longer to fill.

optDescStories.message: "Integrated" tucks Twitch's stories row into the filter block, with the number of channels with unseen stories. Always hidden in Top Channels mode.

optDescSerie.message: "Integrated" tucks Twitch's "Save your streak" row into the filter block, with the streak count. Always hidden in Top Channels mode.

optDescTheme.message: "Auto" follows Twitch's theme. Forcing one only changes how the extension paints on top.

optDescPanneauTheme.message: Separate from the one above: this panel has to paint itself with no Twitch tab open.

optDescPanneauDiag.message: The measurement chapters — lag, cycles, preview, switches — are only there to report a problem.

optDescPurge.message: Each button erases only its own memory. The red button at the bottom erases all of them.

purgeVisitsText.message: The "personal popularity" sort and the rhythm grid will start from zero. Subscriptions and followed channels are untouched.

purgeSubsText.message: The gold will leave the cards until the next sweep. Your visits and followed channels are untouched.

purgeRosterText.message: The list will rebuild itself: the sidebar right away, then the full list from your Following page, reread shortly after. Your visits and subscriptions are untouched.

optImportInvalide.message: That is not a valid set of settings.

optResetTitle.message: Reset every setting to its default?

optResetText.message: All thirty-seven settings on this page will return to their original value. Your data — visits, subscriptions, followed channels — is untouched.

optBadgeSwitch.description: Maquette : badge de basculement de catégorie

optBadgeReprise.description: Maquette : badge de reprise après coupure
